# Intake brief — Audit runner persist path is not cwd-independent

**Work item:** SA-0MSKQERKH002IBLG · `bug` · `high`

> **Headline:** The audit runner's `persist_audit.py` PERSIST path resolved its worklog store from the caller's cwd (unlike the cwd-independent READ path), so audits launched from a non-project cwd failed to persist with `Work item not found`. The planned behaviour is **already implemented and merged into `dev`** (commit `380e45e6`, 2026-08-15) with tests and docs; the remaining wrong-repo (split-brain) facet is **explicitly deferred** and tracked by `SA-0MSRLECW2001AA15`.

> **Intake route:** This item is already implemented, so advancing it to `intake_complete` would dispatch `plan` → `implement` on merged work. It has therefore been **held at `idea` and flagged for producer review** (see Appendix). Recommended route: audit verification and closure.

## Problem statement

The audit runner documented cwd independence, and its READ path honoured that (prefix-to-sibling worklog scan in `skill/shared/status_lifecycle.py`). The PERSIST path did **not**: `skill/audit/scripts/persist_audit.py` injected `--worklog-dir` only when an explicit value was passed. When the runner/CLI was launched from a non-project cwd (e.g. the skill install dir `~/.pi/agent/skills/audit`, which symlinks into this repo) **without** `--worklog-dir`, every `wl` write (`wl audit-set`, the priority-check `wl show`, `wl update --audit-text`, the stage fetch) ran from the runner's cwd and resolved the wrong worklog store, failing with `Work item not found: <prefix>-…` even though the item existed.

## Users

- Developers/agents running `audit_runner.py issue <id>` (or the standalone `persist_audit.py`) from a non-project cwd — the documented cwd-independent pattern.
- Operators relying on audits being persisted regardless of the launch directory, so verdicts are not silently lost.

### Example user stories

- As an agent auditing a work item from the skill install directory, I want the persist path to target the item's own worklog store automatically, so the audit is stored rather than failing with `Work item not found`.
- As an operator, I want an explicit `--worklog-dir` to keep highest precedence, so I can always force a specific store.
- As a developer, I want parent **and** child audit persistence to be cwd-independent, so a parent audit with children records every verdict.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Auto-resolution on every persist command.** Every `wl` command built by `persist_audit.py` resolves `--worklog-dir` via the shared resolution order — explicit value > prefix-to-sibling scan > cwd-chain fallback > no flag — so no persist command runs against the wrong store when launched from a non-project cwd.
2. **Standalone CLI is cwd-independent.** `persist_audit.py --issue-id <id>` invoked from a non-project cwd **without** `--worklog-dir` persists successfully to the item's own store; an explicit `--worklog-dir` still overrides.
3. **Runner path (parent and child) is cwd-independent.** `persist_audit()` called with `worklog_dir=None` from a non-owning cwd targets the item's own store for every `wl` command — `audit-set`, the priority-lowering `wl show` / `wl update --priority`, the stage fetch, and the `--audit-text` update — for parent **and** child audits.
4. **Precedence and fallback preserved.** An explicit `--worklog-dir` beats auto-resolution; when nothing resolves, no flag is injected (`wl` resolves from cwd), preserving the existing failure/return-code contract.
5. **Documentation updated.** `skill/audit/SKILL.md` and `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` state that the persist path is cwd-independent, and note that the remaining repo-scope (`TARGET_PROJECT_ROOT`) consumers stay launch-cwd-bound.
6. **Testing/validation.** Automated tests cover AC1–AC4 (non-project-cwd auto-resolution, explicit override, fallback, parent and child paths) using fake runners only — no real `wl`/`pi` calls.
7. **Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.**

## Constraints

- Reuse the shared resolution in `skill/shared/status_lifecycle.py` (`resolve_worklog_flags`); do not duplicate prefix-scan logic in `persist_audit.py`.
- Preserve the CLI/API contract (`--worklog-dir` remains the highest-precedence override; `persist_audit()` keeps its return-code semantics).
- Keep tests hermetic (injectable runner, patched `SIBLING_SCAN_ROOT`).
- **Out of scope:** making `TARGET_PROJECT_ROOT` (code-quality scan, debug-log path, repo-index fallback) per-audit dynamic. That work is tracked separately by `SA-0MSRLECW2001AA15`.

## Existing state — the fix is already merged

- **Implementation:** commit `380e45e6` "SA-0MSKQERKH002IBLG: Implementation complete" (2026-08-15). `persist_audit.py` gained a `_worklog_flags()` helper that delegates to `resolve_worklog_flags`, and every `wl` command built by the module now routes through it (audit-set, priority `show`/`update`, stage fetch, `--audit-text` update).
- **Merged:** confirmed an ancestor of `HEAD` on `dev` and present on `origin/dev`.
- **Tests:** `skill/audit/tests/test_persist_audit_worklog_dir.py` (8 tests, docstrings referencing AC2/AC3/AC5) plus the existing identity/priority suites — **32 passed** at the time of intake. A live check from `~/.pi/agent/skills/audit` resolves an `LP-…` id to `/home/rgardler/projects/llm-manager/.worklog` without an explicit flag.
- **Docs:** `skill/audit/SKILL.md` and `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` updated in the same commit.
- **Deferred facet:** the commit and docs explicitly note that the repo-scope facet of the skill-dir launch pattern (`TARGET_PROJECT_ROOT` code-quality scan / debug-log consumers) remains launch-cwd-bound — **tracked in `SA-0MSRLECW2001AA15`**.
- **Tracking gap:** the work item was never transitioned past `stage: idea`; the implementation was committed out-of-band, so no `intake_complete`/`plan_complete`/`in_review` history exists, the description was left truncated mid-sentence, and it carries no ACs.

## Desired change

- For the item's own scope (persist path): **no further change is required** — verify the merged implementation against the ACs above and close.
- Ensure the remaining split-brain scope stays owned by `SA-0MSRLECW2001AA15` (do not silently absorb it here).

## Key Files (predicted)

- `skill/audit/scripts/persist_audit.py` — persist-path `wl` commands now resolve `--worklog-dir` via `_worklog_flags()` / `resolve_worklog_flags` (implemented).
- `skill/shared/status_lifecycle.py` — shared resolution order (`resolve_worklog_flags`, `_find_worklog_dir_by_prefix`).
- `skill/audit/tests/test_persist_audit_worklog_dir.py` — new coverage for the persist path (8 tests).
- `skill/audit/SKILL.md`, `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` — cwd-independence documentation.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Already-implemented work re-implemented (highest risk).** Advancing this item to `intake_complete` dispatches `plan` → `implement`, which would target already-merged code. Mitigation: held at `idea` with `needsProducerReview=true` (the dispatcher excludes such items); this brief states the merged fix prominently.
- **Scope confusion with `SA-0MSRLECW2001AA15`.** The residual split-brain work could be duplicated here. Mitigation: explicitly listed as out of scope, with that item as the owner.
- **Evidence freshness.** The ancestry check and 32-test run are point-in-time. Mitigation: the audit re-verifies against current `dev`.
- **Assumption.** The original repro project (`llm`, `LP-…`) is no longer at its old path; resolution was verified against `llm-manager` (prefix `LP`).
- **Assumption.** AC coverage provided by the merged commit (tests + docs) is sufficient for verification; the audit is the arbiter.
- **Scope-creep note.** Any additional cwd-dependence found while verifying (beyond the persist path) should be recorded as a linked work item, not absorbed here.

## Related work

- **`SA-0MSG48MEI0083K82`** (completed) — the READ-path equivalent: "Audit runner cwd-independence broken: worklog store not resolved when launched outside the audited project". This item's fix mirrors that resolution.
- **`SA-0MSLLGDW00098UCC`** (completed, `in_review`) — made the git-derived pieces (file-scope manifest, changed-file list, HEAD sha, working-tree hash) resolve against the worklog-derived owning project root.
- **`SA-0MSRLECW2001AA15`** (open) — the deferred facet: make `TARGET_PROJECT_ROOT` per-audit dynamic (code-quality scan, debug-log path, repo-index fallback). Explicitly the residual of the split-brain finding recorded on this item.
- **`SA-0MSAXHBS5008R97M`** (completed) — tests for cwd-independent `wl` lifecycle and diagnostics.
- **`SA-0MSRMFSZL007CZVQ`** (completed) — documentation of the corrected scope semantics.
- **`SA-0MTHC710X003ORZM`**, **`SA-0MSL1YX24000V2MG`** — automated related-work matches (audit persistence / worklog-dir resolution caching).
- **Automated report:** `.worklog/tmp/find-related-full-SA-0MSKQERKH002IBLG.md`.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- **Q (OPEN QUESTION — producer decision required):** The persist-path fix described by this item is already merged into `dev` (commit `380e45e6`, 2026-08-15) with tests and docs, and the residual wrong-repo (split-brain) facet is explicitly deferred to `SA-0MSRLECW2001AA15`. Should this item be (a) routed straight to audit verification and closure, or (b) kept at `idea` and re-scoped (e.g. expanded to absorb `SA-0MSRLECW2001AA15`)? — **Answer:** _pending producer input._ Research: inspected the merged commit `380e45e6` (files/tests/docs), confirmed ancestry on `origin/dev`, ran the related suites (32 passed), and live-verified prefix resolution from the skill install dir. The item was held at `idea` and flagged `needsProducerReview=true` because advancing it to `intake_complete` would dispatch `plan` → `implement` on already-merged work.
- **Q:** Which worklog store does the persist path target when no `--worklog-dir` is passed? — **Answer (agent, from code):** the shared prefix-to-sibling scan, then the cwd-chain fallback (or no flag). Source: `skill/shared/status_lifecycle.py` + `persist_audit._worklog_flags`.
- **Q:** Is the split-brain (`TARGET_PROJECT_ROOT`) facet in scope for this item? — **Answer (agent, from the merged commit's docs):** no; it is explicitly deferred to `SA-0MSRLECW2001AA15`. Source: `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` note added in `380e45e6`.

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **SA-0MTHC710X003ORZM** – Audit staleness race: post-persist comment bumps updatedAt past auditedAt — passed audits show stale icon (completed)
- **SA-0MSL1YX24000V2MG** – Cache worklog-dir resolution to stop per-wl-call sibling scans (completed)
- **SA-0MTYJ5VFI003PZMI** – [CRITICAL] /home/rgardler/projects/SorraAgents/skill/standup/tests/test_generate_standup_worklog_dir.py:173 — Local variable `rc` is assigned to but never used (F841) (open)

### Repository file matches
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — matched: acs, agent, audit, auditing, bash (+84 more)
- `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` — matched: acs, agent, audit, auditing, bash (+80 more)
- `skill/audit/SKILL.md` — matched: acs, agent, audit, auditing, bash (+75 more)

# Verification & hardening of incident recovery

## Goal

Verify all recovery acceptance criteria for SA-0MU89WA740004GOJ are met and harden the local git state so the destructive commit `2c30dbfe` is fully purged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Parent AC1 — Local `dev` branch restored to full repository tree: verified by `git rev-parse HEAD` pointing at a valid commit on `origin/dev` and `git status` clean (unrelated other-agent working-tree modifications excepted and recorded).
- Parent AC2 — Destructive commit `2c30dbfe` unreachable from any local branch: verified by `git for-each-ref --contains 2c30dbfe` returning empty across all branches and worktrees.
- Parent AC3 — Test-isolation guard added to `TestRootFileOnlyRepoManifest._init_repo`: the fixture asserts `tmp_path` is not inside a git repository before executing `git init`, and a regression test `test_init_repo_refuses_live_repo_tmp_path` verifies this guard.
- Flake-free verification — reflog entries referencing `2c30dbfe` are expired (`git reflog expire --expire=now --all`) and the object pruned (`git gc --prune=now`), so `git cat-file -t 2c30dbfe` reports the object no longer exists.
- Audit suite green — `pytest -q -r a --disable-warnings skill/audit/` passes, confirming the guard changes introduce no regressions in the affected suite.
- Evidence recorded — the output of every verification command above is captured in a comment on this work item.
## Constraints

- Do not disturb other agents' worktrees or branches.
- Only the main checkout's git state may be touched.

## Key Files

- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_launch_context.py` — fixture guard + regression test.
data.title: Verify & harden incident recovery
